acceptanceCriteria: Enforce the configured retries.admissionsPerRevision consistently in explicit/next claim, preview including pool/stage, and owner retry recovery, with documented bounded/default/zero semantics and preserved historical accounting.
Retain meaningful boundary and actual disposable CLI/store qualification, old-client compatibility limits, focused checks, independent review and exact owning-spec/CEM/OCM evidence.
Keep the ticket open until verified public integration and native submit/gate/completion succeed; do not change the live queue policy or erase historical retry debt.
body:
Owning issue: https://github.com/beamfall/corvint/issues/420
Direct owner requested fixing newly filed GitHub tickets on 2026-10-01 in the ongoing all-issues batch. Preserve original complete issue intent below. Independent baseline confirms the reported behavior; no source repair or live policy/store migration performed. Core rc.1 build163; Tasks developer build202.

## Summary

The queue policy accepts `retries.admissionsPerRevision`, but the retry-exhaustion checks ignore it. A queue cannot change its retry budget, even after the #412 hand-off accounting fix (PR #414).

## Evidence (main @ d693d28)

- `internal/tasks/intent/policy.go:257` parses the field: `p.AdmissionsPerRevision = boundCount(rt.Field("admissionsPerRevision"), 0, wire.MaxAdmissionsPerRev)`. `wire.MaxAdmissionsPerRev` is 3, so the policy cannot raise it above 3.
- `internal/tasks/transaction/lease.go:36` defines `MaxRetries = 3`. Exhaustion uses that constant, not the policy value: `internal/tasks/transaction/lease_handoff.go:20` (`exhaustedAttempt`), and the plan and retry-recovery paths noted in #412.

## Impact

Our multi-agent queue (361 tickets, 3 lanes, up to 16 concurrent external agents) loses a retry whenever an agent session dies or its lease expires. With HANDOFF/REVIEW_RETURNED, clean hand-offs are now free, but crash or expiry still uses a retry. The budget of 3 cannot be tuned, and every exhaustion needs an OWNER `ticket reopen`.

## Request

Wire `retries.admissionsPerRevision` into the exhaustion checks, in claim, preview and owner recovery alike. Allow a policy value above 3 within a documented bound, or document that the field is informational and reject values other than the constant.

Follow-up to the last comment on #412.
title: GH #420: corvint-tasks: retries.admissionsPerRevision is parsed but never enforced; exhaustion still uses the hard-coded MaxRetries = 3
